name: @context-manager/desktop
description: Local-first screen context capture for AI (Context Manager desktop)
author: Basis Labs

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:main && pnpm build:renderer
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @context-manager/config build && pnpm --filter @context-manager/core build && pnpm --filter @context-manager/mcp-server build
scripts.build:binaries: pnpm build:ocr-helper && pnpm build:ffmpeg-bundle && pnpm build:cloudflared-bundle
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm build && pnpm build:mcp-bundle && pnpm build:binaries
scripts.dist: pnpm build:desktop && cd ../.. && pnpm exec electron-builder --project apps/desktop
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm build:desktop && cd ../.. && pnpm exec electron-builder --dir --project apps/desktop
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:main && concurrently -k "node ../mcp_server/dist/server.js" "vite --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && node scripts/start-electron.js"
